lesson.grammar_point: present simple for jobs and responsibilities (third person -s, do and does)

listenings.text: Hi, I'm Emma, and I'm an HR manager in London. My company makes software, and about four hundred people work there. I report to the HR director, and I'm in charge of two areas: training and benefits. On Mondays I meet my team, and we plan the week. Every month we hire new people, so I organize their first days. Payroll is not my job: a colleague in the finance department takes care of it. My favorite part of the job is training new managers. They don't always know how to give feedback, and I help them. It's a busy job, but I love it.

Hello, my name is Daan, and I live in Amsterdam. I'm a recruiter: I hire people for an international company. I usually go to the office by bike. It takes fifteen minutes, and there is no traffic. In my department there are six people, and we all report to the Head of HR. I talk to candidates every day, on the phone and online. My colleagues come from many countries, so we speak English at work, not Dutch. On Fridays I work from home. I don't have meetings on Fridays, so I read CVs and write job posts.
